basic_info.description: Discover an incredible opportunity to own a spacious home in one of San Francisco's most vibrant neighborhoods! Nestled in the heart of the Mission District, this fixer-upper is brimming with potential whether you're looking to restore its historic charm, reimagine it as a modern masterpiece, or create a multi-unit investment property (buyer to verify). With a flexible layout, it offers ample room for expansion and customization. The deep lot presents additional possibilities, including a backyard retreat or ADU potential. Featuring high ceilings, period details, and generous living spaces, this property is ready for your vision. San Francisco Planning has approved "Entitlement" for the construction of a four-story, seven-unit modern apartment building. The owners are selling the combined property, architectural designs, and entitlement plans.
